summary: MaxsMaking Inc., a BVI-incorporated Shanghai textile manufacturer listed on a US exchange, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 28, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting, held 10:00 a.m. ET with an August 26, 2026 record date. Shareholders approved (i) amending and restating the Articles to eliminate the B share class, following the August 25, 2026 redesignation of all B shares as A shares, leaving a single class of unlimited $0.01 A shares, and (ii) continuation from the BVI and re-domestication as a Delaware corporation. Both passed overwhelmingly, roughly 14.85 million votes for. This is a routine governance/re-domiciliation matter, not a special situation; watch BVI and Delaware registration timing and any change to shareholder rights or index eligibility.
